Q-Matrix Explorer

Drag A and B to any cell on the board, click a player to give them the ball, and watch the exact solver's payoff matrix and equilibrium action probabilities update live. Switch between the stochastic rules (random move order) and the deterministic rules (both moves resolve at once), and compare the same position with and without STAND. Show each mix as solved (unrounded) or rounded to quarters or thirds. Compare the exact solver against a trained agent (Nash-DQN on the stochastic game, PPO on the deterministic one), and pick which agent plays each side in a match.
